instruction: In SolveSpace, import seed_ss_gui_16_handle.dxf from /home/user/Desktop using the GUI DXF import workflow (File > Import), then continue editing that imported drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Do not use File > Open or launch the DXF as a native SolveSpace file. Use the existing end guides, tangent lines, and internal-opening guide to create the final handle-shaped outer outline with overall size 160 x 50, a semicircle of radius 25 at each left and right end, and top/bottom horizontal tangent lines between them. Add one centered internal opening of 100 x 14. Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. Save the completed drawing as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_16.dxf. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
